title.zh: 卷八 本紀第八: 世宗下
title.raw: 卷八 本紀第八: 世宗下 Volume 8 Annals 8: Shizong 3

sentences.zh: 二十一年正月戊申朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Year 21, first month, on wushen the new moon: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21, on the wushen new moon of the first month, congratulatory envoys arrived from Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以夏國請，詔複綏德軍榷場，仍許就館市易。

translations.literal: On renzi, at Western Xia’s request, an edict restored the Suide Army market and still allowed trade at the embassy lodge.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, at Western Xia’s request, the throne reopened the Suide Army border market and allowed trade at the embassy lodge as before.

sentences.zh: 上聞山東、大名等路猛安謀克之民，驕縱奢侈，不事耕稼。

translations.literal: The emperor heard that among the meng’an and mouke people of Shandong, Daming, and other circuits they were arrogant, extravagant, and did not farm.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor learned that meng’an and mouke households in Shandong, Daming, and other circuits had grown proud and lavish, and neglected the plow.

sentences.zh: 詔遣閱實，計口授地，必令自耕，地有餘而力不贍者，方許招人租佃，仍禁農時飲酒。

translations.literal: An edict sent men to verify registers, allocate land by headcount, and require self-cultivation; only where land was surplus and labor insufficient might they recruit tenants—drinking in farming season was still forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered a survey: land was to be assigned by household size and worked by the holders themselves; renting out surplus fields was permitted only when hands fell short, and drinking during the farming season remained forbidden.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，追貶海陵煬王亮為庶人，詔中外。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Hailing Tyrant King Liang was posthumously degraded to commoner rank, and the edict was announced within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Hailing Tyrant King Liang was posthumously stripped to commoner rank, and the decree was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 甲子，如春水。

translations.literal: On jiazi, he went to the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he went to the spring-waters hunt.

sentences.zh: 丙子，次永清縣。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he halted at Yongqing County.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he halted at Yongqing County.

sentences.zh: 有移剌餘裏也者，契丹人也，隸虞王猛安，有一妻一妾。

translations.literal: There was one Yelü Yuliye, a Khitan registered under the King Yu meng’an, who had one wife and one concubine.
translations.idiomatic: A Khitan named Yelü Yuliye, registered under the King Yu meng’an, had one wife and one concubine.

sentences.zh: 妻之子六，妾之子四。

translations.literal: The wife had six sons; the concubine had four.
translations.idiomatic: The wife bore six sons; the concubine bore four.

sentences.zh: 妻死，其六子廬墓下，更宿守之。

translations.literal: When the wife died, her six sons built huts by the tomb and took turns keeping night watch.
translations.idiomatic: When the wife died, her six sons built mourning huts at the grave and kept vigil in rotation.

sentences.zh: 妾之子皆曰：「是嫡母也，我輩獨不當守墳墓乎？

translations.literal: The concubine’s sons all said: “She was the legitimate mother—are we alone not to guard the grave?”
translations.idiomatic: The concubine’s sons said: “She was the legitimate mother—should we alone leave the tomb unwatched?”

sentences.zh: 」於是，亦更宿焉，三歲如一。

translations.literal: Thereupon they too kept watch in turn, for three years without break.
translations.idiomatic: So they joined the watch in turn, and for three years kept to the same rule.

sentences.zh: 上因獵，過而聞之，賜錢五百貫，仍令縣官積錢于市，以示縣民，然後給之，以為孝子之勸。

translations.literal: The emperor, hunting, passed by and heard of it; he granted five hundred strings of cash and still ordered the county magistrate to pile the money in the market to show the county people, then pay it out, as encouragement to filial sons.
translations.idiomatic: Hunting nearby, the emperor heard the tale and gave five hundred strings of cash, bidding the magistrate stack the coins in the market for all to see before paying the reward—an example to filial sons.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Second month, on wuxu, the Great White star was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuxu, Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 庚子，還都。

translations.literal: On gengzi, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以河南尹張景仁為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On renyin, Henan Intendant Zhang Jingren was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Zhang Jingren, intendant of Henan, was named censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以元妃李氏之喪，致祭興德宮，過市肆不聞樂聲，謂宰臣曰：「豈以妃故禁之耶？

translations.literal: On yisi, because of primary consort Lady Li’s mourning, he performed sacrifice at Xingde Palace; passing the markets he heard no music and told the chief ministers: “Is this banned for the consort’s sake?”
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, mourning primary consort Lady Li, he sacrificed at Xingde Palace; the markets were silent as he passed, and he asked the chief ministers: “Have you silenced the city for the consort?”

sentences.zh: 細民日作而食，若禁之是廢其生計也，其勿禁。

translations.literal: Common folk work day by day for their food; if we forbid it we destroy their livelihood—do not forbid it.
translations.idiomatic: The people live from day labor; forbid their trade and you ruin their bread—let it be.

sentences.zh: 朕前將詣興德宮，有司請由薊門，朕恐妨市民生業，特從他道。

translations.literal: When I was going to Xingde Palace earlier, the offices asked me to take Ji Gate, but I feared harming the townspeople’s livelihood and deliberately used another route.
translations.idiomatic: When I went to Xingde Palace before, the offices wanted me through Ji Gate, but I took another road lest I harm the townspeople’s trade.

sentences.zh: 顧見街衢門肆，或有毀撤，障以簾箔，何必爾也。

translations.literal: Yet I saw streets and shopfronts in places torn down and screened with curtains and matting—why go so far?
translations.idiomatic: Still I saw lanes and shops pulled down in places, hung with curtains and reed screens—what need was there?

sentences.zh: 自今勿複毀撤。」

translations.literal: From now on, do not tear them down again.”
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter, do not tear them down again.”

sentences.zh: 三月丁未朔，萬春節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Third month, on dingwei the new moon, Wan Spring Festival: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei new moon of the third month, at the Wan Spring Festival, congratulatory envoys came from Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 上初聞薊、平、灤等州民乏食，命有司發粟糶之，貧不能糴或貸之。

translations.literal: The emperor had first heard that the people of Ji, Ping, Luan, and other prefectures lacked food and ordered the responsible offices to issue grain for sale; those too poor to buy were to be lent grain.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that Ji, Ping, Luan, and other prefectures were short of food, he first ordered grain sold from government stores and grain lent to those too poor to buy.

sentences.zh: 有司以貸貧民恐不能償，止貸有戶籍者。

translations.literal: The offices, fearing the poor could not repay, lent only to households on the register.
translations.idiomatic: The offices, fearing the poor would never repay, lent only to registered households.

sentences.zh: 上至長春宮，聞之，更遣人閱實，賑貸。

translations.literal: When the emperor reached Changchun Palace and heard of it, he again sent men to verify and grant relief loans.
translations.idiomatic: At Changchun Palace he heard of it and sent men to verify the rolls and extend relief loans anew.

sentences.zh: 以監察禦史石抹元禮、鄭達卿不糾舉，各笞四十，前所遣官皆論罪。

translations.literal: Supervising censors Shi Mo Yuanli and Zheng Daqing, for not impeaching, each received forty strokes of the staff; the officials sent earlier were all punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising censors Shi Mo Yuanli and Zheng Daqing, who had failed to impeach, were each beaten forty strokes; every earlier envoy was punished as the law required.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the Great White star was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔山后冒占官地十頃以上者皆籍入官，均給貧民。

translations.literal: On yichou, an edict: monks who had encroached on more than ten qing of official land were all registered into state ownership and evenly allotted to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou an edict declared that monks holding more than ten qing of official land would have it registered to the state and divided among the poor.

sentences.zh: 遼州民硃忠等亂言，伏誅。

translations.literal: At Liaozhou, Zhu Zhong and others spread seditious talk and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: At Liaozhou Zhu Zhong and others spread seditious talk and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 上謂宰臣曰：「近聞宗州節度使阿思懣行事多不法，通州刺史完顏守能既與招討職事，猶不守廉。

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief ministers: “I have lately heard that Zongzhou military commissioner Asi Men does many unlawful things, and Tongzhou prefect Wanyan Shouneng, though he holds pacification duties, still will not keep himself honest.
translations.idiomatic: He told the chief ministers: “I hear Zongzhou commissioner Asi Men breaks the law at every turn, and Tongzhou prefect Wanyan Shouneng, though charged with pacification, still will not live cleanly.

sentences.zh: 達官貴要多行非理，監察未嘗興劾。

translations.literal: High officials and the great often do what is unreasonable, yet the censorate has never opened a case.
translations.idiomatic: Great men do as they please, yet the censorate never stirs.

sentences.zh: 斡睹只群牧副使僕散那也取部人二球仗，至細事也，乃便劾奏。

translations.literal: Wudai only herd vice commissioner Pusan Naye took two ball sticks from his tribesmen—a trifling matter—and at once you impeach him.
translations.idiomatic: Pusan Naye, a vice commissioner of the Wudai herd office, took two ball sticks from his tribesmen—a petty thing—and you impeach him at once.

sentences.zh: 謂之稱職，可乎？

translations.literal: And you call that doing your duty—can it be so?
translations.idiomatic: You call that competence—can it be so?

sentences.zh: 今監察職事修舉者與遷擢，不稱者，大則降罰，小則決責，仍不許去官。」

translations.literal: From now on, censors who fully perform their duties are to be promoted; those who do not—in major cases demoted and fined, in minor cases beaten, and still not allowed to leave office.”
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth censors who do their work shall be advanced; those who fail—in grave cases demoted and fined, in light cases flogged, and in neither case allowed to resign.”

sentences.zh: 閏月己卯，恩州民鄒明等亂言，伏誅。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on jimao, at Enzhou Zou Ming and others spread seditious talk and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jimao, Zou Ming and others at Enzhou spread seditious talk and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，漁陽令夾穀移裏罕、司候判官劉居漸以被命賑貸，止給富戶，各削三官，通州刺史郭邦傑總其事，奪俸三月。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Yuyang magistrate Jiagu Yilihan and the judicial-assistant magistrate Liu Jujian, charged with relief lending, gave only to rich households; each was stripped of three ranks. Tongzhou prefect Guo Bangjie, who oversaw the matter, had his salary withheld three months.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Yuyang magistrate Jiagu Yilihan and judicial assistant Liu Jujian, ordered to lend relief grain, supplied only rich households; each lost three ranks. Tongzhou prefect Guo Bangjie, who oversaw them, forfeited three months’ salary.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上謂宰臣曰：「朕觀自古人君多進用讒諂，其間蒙蔽，為害非細，若漢明帝尚為此輩惑之。

translations.literal: On yiwei, the emperor told the chief ministers: “I observe that since antiquity many rulers have advanced slanderers; the concealment they work is no small harm—even Han Mingdi was still deceived by such men.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he told the chief ministers: “Since antiquity rulers have too often raised flatterers; the harm of their hidden poison is not slight—even Han Mingdi was misled by such men.

sentences.zh: 朕雖不及古之明君，然近習讒言，未嘗入耳。

translations.literal: I do not equal the bright rulers of old, yet slander from close attendants has never entered my ears.
translations.idiomatic: I am no sage of antiquity, yet the whispers of flatterers have never reached my ears.

sentences.zh: 至於宰輔之臣，亦未嘗偏用一人私議也。

translations.literal: As for the chief ministers, I have never been partial to one man’s private counsel.”
translations.idiomatic: Nor have I ever let one minister’s private counsel sway the cabinet.”

sentences.zh: 」癸卯，以尚書左丞相完顏守道為太尉、尚書令，尚書左丞蒲察通為平章政事，右丞襄為左丞，參知政事張汝弼為右丞，彰德軍節度使梁肅為參知政事。

translations.literal: On guimao, Left Chief Councillor Wanyan Shoudao was made Grand Guardian and Chief Minister; Left Vice Councillor Pucha Tong was made Grand Councillor; Right Vice Councillor Xiang became Left Vice; Participation Councillor Zhang Rubi became Right Vice; Zhangde Army military commissioner Liang Su became participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Left Chief Councillor Wanyan Shoudao became grand guardian and chief minister; Left Vice Councillor Pucha Tong became grand councillor; Right Vice Xiang became left vice; Participation Councillor Zhang Rubi became right vice; and Zhangde Army commissioner Liang Su became participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 四月戊申，以右丞相徒單克甯為左丞相，平章政事唐括安禮為右丞相。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on wushen, Right Chief Councillor Tushan Kening was made left chief councillor, and Grand Councillor Tangkuo Anli was made right chief councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on wushen, Right Chief Councillor Tushan Kening became left chief councillor and Grand Councillor Tangkuo Anli became right chief councillor.

sentences.zh: 增築泰州、臨潢府等路邊堡及屋宇。

translations.literal: Border forts and buildings on the Taizhou, Linhuangfu, and other routes were enlarged and repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Border forts and barracks on the Taizhou, Linhuang, and other routes were enlarged and repaired.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，奉安昭祖以下三福三宗禦容于衍慶宮，行親祀禮。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the imperial portraits from Zhaozu down through the three blessings and three ancestors were installed at Yanqing Palace, and the kin-sacrifice rites were performed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the imperial portraits from Zhaozu through the three blessings and three ancestors were enshrined at Yanqing Palace, and the kin-sacrifice rites were performed.

sentences.zh: 上諭宰臣曰：「朕之言行豈能無過？

translations.literal: The emperor instructed the chief ministers: “Can my words and deeds be without fault?”
translations.idiomatic: He told the chief ministers: “Can my words and deeds be without fault?”

sentences.zh: 常欲人直諫而無肯言者。

translations.literal: I always want men to speak frankly, yet none will.
translations.idiomatic: I long for blunt counsel, yet none will offer it.

sentences.zh: 使其言果善，朕從而行之，又何難也。

translations.literal: If their words are truly good, I follow and act—what is difficult in that?”
translations.idiomatic: When the advice is sound, I act on it—what is hard in that?”

sentences.zh: 」戊辰，以滕王府長史把德固為橫賜夏國使。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Badegu, chief steward of the Prince of Teng’s establishment, was made envoy on the lateral-bestowal mission to Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Badegu, chief steward of the Prince of Teng’s house, was sent as lateral-bestowal envoy to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 壬申，幸壽安宮。

translations.literal: On renshen, he visited Shou’an Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he visited Shou’an Palace.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，西北路招討使完顏守能以贓罪，杖二百，除名。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on wuzi, Northwest Route pacification commissioner Wanyan Shouneng, for bribery, was beaten two hundred strokes and dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuzi, Northwest Route pacification commissioner Wanyan Shouneng, convicted of bribery, was flogged two hundred strokes and expelled from office.

sentences.zh: 七月丙戌，還都。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on bingxu, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on bingxu, he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，樞密使趙王永中罷。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Privy Commissioner Zhao Yongzhong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Privy Commissioner Zhao Yongzhong left office.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以左丞相徒單克甯為樞密使。

translations.literal: On jihai, Left Chancellor Tuodan Kening was made privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Left Chancellor Tuodan Kening was appointed privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以太尉、尚書令完顏守道複為左丞相，太尉如故。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Grand Guardian and Director of the Secretariat Wanyan Shoudao was again made left chancellor, grand guardian as before.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Grand Guardian and Secretariat Director Wanyan Shoudao resumed the left chancellorship while keeping his grand guardian rank.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，以右副都點檢胡什賚等為賀宋生日使，吏部郎中奚胡失海為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on yichou, Right Deputy Palace Inspector Hushen and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the imperial birthday; Personnel Section chief Xi Husihai was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yichou, Right Deputy Palace Inspector Hushen and others were sent as Song birthday envoys, and Personnel Section Chief Xi Husihai as Western Xia birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 二十二年三月辛未朔，萬春節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀，丁丑，命尚書省申敕西北路招討司勒猛安謀克官督部人習武備。

translations.literal: Year 22, third month, on xinwei the new moon, Wan Spring Festival; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations. On dingchou the Secretariat was ordered to transmit an edict to the Northwest Route Pacification Commissioner that meng’an and mouke officers should supervise their people in martial readiness.
translations.idiomatic: Year 22, third month, new moon on xinwei: at the Wan Spring Festival congratulatory envoys came from Song, Goryeo, and Xia. On dingchou the Secretariat was told to instruct the Northwest Route Pacification Commissioner that meng’an and mouke officers must drill their people in arms.

sentences.zh: 甲申，諭戶部：「今歲行幸山后，所須並不得取之民間，雖所用人夫，並以官錢和雇，違者杖八十，罷職。

translations.literal: On jiashen, he instructed the Revenue Ministry: 「This year when I travel to the mountains rear, nothing required may be taken from the people; even laborers employed shall be hired with official funds. Violators receive eighty blows and forfeiture of office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he directed the Revenue Ministry: 「On this year’s tour of the mountains rear, take nothing from the populace; even corvee labor must be paid from official funds. Offenders—eighty strokes and dismissal.

sentences.zh: 」癸巳，詔頒重修制條。

translations.literal: 」On guisi, an edict promulgated the revised code of regulations.
translations.idiomatic: 」On guisi an edict issued the revised statute book.

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書張汝霖為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Personnel Minister Zhang Rulin was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Personnel Minister Zhang Rulin was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 四月乙卯，行監臨院務官食直法。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on yimao, the supervisory market officials’ ration-pay law was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on yimao, the law fixing stipends for supervisory market officials took effect.

sentences.zh: 以削明肅尊號，詔中外，從皇太子請也。

translations.literal: Because the Mingsu honorific title was removed, an edict was sent throughout the court and the realm, at the crown prince’s request.
translations.idiomatic: At the crown prince’s request, the throne stripped the Mingsu honorific and proclaimed it throughout court and realm.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上如金蓮川。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the emperor went to Golden Lotus Stream.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he went to Golden Lotus Stream.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jiashen, Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiashen, Venus was seen by day.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子朔，制立限放良之奴，限內娶良人為妻，所生男女即為良。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on gengzi the new moon, regulations were set: bondservants manumitted within a time limit who within that limit marry commoners—the children born are commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, new moon on gengzi: a rule fixed that bondservants freed within a set term who marry commoners before the term ends—their offspring are freeborn.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，右丞相致仕石琚薨。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Right Chancellor, retired, Shi Ju died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi retired Right Chancellor Shi Ju died.

sentences.zh: 七月辛巳，宰臣奏事，上頗違豫，宰臣請退。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on xinsi, the chief ministers memorialized on business; the emperor was somewhat unwell and the ministers asked to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinsi, the chief ministers were reporting affairs when the emperor felt somewhat indisposed and they asked leave to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「豈以朕之微爽於和，而倦臨朝之大政耶？

translations.literal: The emperor said: 「Would I, because of a slight lapse of harmony in my person, grow weary of presiding over great affairs of state?
translations.idiomatic: He said: 「Am I to neglect the weight of government because my health is slightly off?

sentences.zh: 」使終其奏。

translations.literal: 」He had them finish the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: 」He told them to complete their report.

sentences.zh: 甲午，秋獵。

translations.literal: On jiawu, autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the autumn hunt began.

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰，太白經天。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on wuchen, Venus crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuchen, Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，至自金蓮川。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on wuyin, he returned from Golden Lotus Stream.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuyin, he returned from Golden Lotus Stream.

sentences.zh: 以左衛將軍禪赤等為賀宋生日使，尚輦局使僕散曷速罕為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: Left Guard General Chanci and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the imperial birthday; Imperial Carriage Bureau commissioner Pusan Hesuhan was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Left Guard General Chanci and others were sent as Song birthday envoys; Imperial Carriage Bureau Commissioner Pusan Hesuhan as Western Xia birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以同知東京留守司事裔在任專恣，失上下之分，謫授複州刺史。

translations.literal: On jichou, Associate Eastern Capital Regent Yi, while in office tyrannical, lost the proper relation between superior and subordinate, and was demoted to prefect of Fu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Yi, deputy regent of the Eastern Capital, for lording it over others in office and forgetting rank—was demoted to prefect of Fu.

sentences.zh: 乙未，壽刺史訛裏也、同知查剌、軍事判官孫紹先、榷場副使韓仲英等以受商賂縱禁物出界，皆處死。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Shou Prefect Elibaye, Vice Prefect Chala, military judge Sun Shaoxian, border-market deputy commissioner Han Zhongying and others, for taking merchants’ bribes and letting contraband cross the border, were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Shou Prefect Elibaye, Vice Prefect Chala, military judge Sun Shaoxian, border-market deputy Han Zhongying, and others—for taking merchants’ bribes and letting banned goods out—were all put to death.

sentences.zh: 十月辛丑，從河間宗室于平州。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on xinchou, Hejian royal clansmen were moved to Ping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on xinchou, clansmen from Hejian were relocated to Pingzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，袷享於太廟。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the combined seasonal sacrifice was performed at the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the combined offering was made at the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，以吏部尚書孛朮魯阿魯罕等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingzi, Personnel Minister Bolülu Aluhan and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingzi, Personnel Minister Bolülu Aluhan and others were sent as Song New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 東京留守徒單貞以與海陵逆謀，伏誅。

translations.literal: Eastern Capital Regent Tudan Zhen, for complicity in Hailing’s treason, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Capital Regent Tudan Zhen was executed for joining Hailing’s plot.

sentences.zh: 妻永平縣主，子慎思並賜死。

translations.literal: His wife, Lady of Yongping County, and his son Shensi were both granted death.
translations.idiomatic: His wife, the Lady of Yongping County, and his son Shensi were granted death as well.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以宿直將軍僕散忠佐為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Night-Duty General Pusan Zhongzuo was made Goryeo birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Night-Duty General Pusan Zhongzuo was sent as Goryeo birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 玉田縣令移剌查坐贓，伏誅。

translations.literal: Yutian County Magistrate Yila Cha, convicted of corruption, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Yila Cha, magistrate of Yutian, was executed on a corruption charge.

sentences.zh: 戊子，冬獵。

translations.literal: On wuzi, winter hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the winter hunt began.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，還都。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on gengzi, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengzi, he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，獵近郊。

translations.literal: On guichou, he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，立強取諸部羊馬法。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the law on forcible seizure of sheep and horses from the various tribes was established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou a statute was enacted against forcibly taking sheep and horses from the tribal peoples.

sentences.zh: 二十三年正月丁卯，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀，庚午，詔有司但獲強盜，跡狀既明，賞隨給之，勿得更待。

translations.literal: Year 23, first month, on dingmao: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations. On gengwu, an edict ordered that whenever offices seize bandits and the facts are clear, rewards shall be given forthwith and not held up for further review.
translations.idiomatic: Year 23, first month, on dingmao: congratulatory envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Xia. On gengwu an edict ruled that when robbers were caught and the case was clear, bounty was to be paid at once without further delay.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，參知政事梁肅致仕。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Participation Councillor Liang Su retired.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Participation Councillor Liang Su retired from office.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，廣樂園燈山火。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the lantern mountain at Guangleyuan caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the lantern mound at Guangleyuan burned.

sentences.zh: 壬午，如春水，詔夾道三十裏內被役之民與免今年租稅，仍給傭直。

translations.literal: On renwu, he went to the spring-waters hunt; an edict exempted corvee people within thirty li on either side of the route from this year’s rent and tax and also granted hire wages.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he went to the spring hunt; within thirty li along the route corvee folk were exempted from the year’s rent and tax and paid hire wages.

sentences.zh: 甲午，大邦基伏誅。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Dabangji was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Dabangji was put to death.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，還都。

translations.literal: Second month, on yisi, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yisi, he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以尚書右丞張汝弼攝太尉，致祭于至聖文宣王廟。

translations.literal: On wushen, Right Assistant Director Zhang Rubi acted as Grand Guardian and conducted sacrifice at the temple of the Sage and Exalted King of Culture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Right Assistant Director Zhang Rubi, acting as grand guardian, offered sacrifice at the temple of Confucius.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以戶部尚書張仲愈為參知政事。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Revenue Minister Zhang Zhongyu was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Revenue Minister Zhang Zhongyu was appointed participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 禦史台進所察州縣官罪，上覽之曰：「卿等所廉皆細碎事，又止錄其惡而不舉其善，審如是，其為官者不亦難乎？

translations.literal: The Censorate submitted offenses it had investigated among prefectural and county officials; the emperor, reviewing them, said: 「What you have exposed are all petty matters, and you record only their evil without citing their good. If that is really so, is it not hard to be an official?
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate reported crimes it had found among local officials. The emperor read the list and said: 「You dredge up trivia, and you note only faults—not virtues. If that is how it is, who could serve as an official?

sentences.zh: 其並察善惡以聞。」

translations.literal: 」Investigate both good and evil alike and report.」
translations.idiomatic: 」Report good and bad together.」

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅朔，萬春節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Third month, on bingyin the new moon, Wan Spring Festival; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, new moon on bingyin: at the Wan Spring Festival congratulatory envoys came from Song, Goryeo, and Xia.

sentences.zh: 丙子，初制宣命之寶，金、玉各一。

translations.literal: On bingzi, for the first time edict seals of command were fashioned, one of gold and one of jade.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the imperial command seals were first cast—one gold, one jade.

sentences.zh: 尚書右丞相烏古論元忠罷。

translations.literal: Right Chancellor of the Secretariat Wugulun Yuanzhong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Right Chancellor Wugulun Yuanzhong left office.

sentences.zh: 潞州涉縣人陳圓亂言，伏誅。

translations.literal: Chen Yuan of She County, Lu Prefecture, for seditious speech, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yuan of She County in Lu Prefecture was executed for treasonable talk.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，雨土。

translations.literal: On yiyou, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔戒諭中外百官。

translations.literal: On bingxu, an edict admonished all officials within and without the court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu an edict warned every official, civil and military, within and beyond the capital.

sentences.zh: 四月辛丑，更定奉使三國人從差遣格。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on xinchou, the regulations on attendants and dispatch for envoys to the three states were revised.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on xinchou, the rules governing staff and missions to Song, Goryeo, and Xia were revised.

sentences.zh: 祁州刺史大磐坐無罪掠死染工，妄認良人二十五口為奴，削官四階，罷之。

translations.literal: Qizhou prefect Dapan, for having without cause plundered and killed a dyeworker and falsely registered twenty-five commoners as slaves, was stripped of four ranks and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Dapan, prefect of Qizhou, had looted and killed a dyeworker without cause and falsely enslaved twenty-five commoners; he was demoted four ranks and removed from office.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，地生白毛。

translations.literal: On guichou white fibers issued from the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou white filaments sprouted from the earth.

sentences.zh: 以大理正紇石主列速為橫賜高麗使，壬戌，幸壽安宮，剌有司為民禱雨。

translations.literal: Court of Review rectifier Heishi Zhuliesu was made lateral-bestowal envoy to Goryeo; on renxu he visited Shou’an Palace and charged the offices to pray for rain on the people’s behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Heishi Zhuliesu, rectifier of the Court of Review, was named lateral-bestowal envoy to Goryeo; on renxu he went to Shou’an Palace and ordered the ministries to pray for rain for the people.

sentences.zh: 是夕，雨。

translations.literal: That evening it rained.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell that night.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，縣令大雛訛只等十人以不任職罷歸。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on gengwu, county magistrate Dadu E’zhi and ten others were dismissed and sent home for incompetence.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengwu, county magistrate Dadu E’zhi and ten others were removed and sent home for failing in office.

sentences.zh: 六十以上者進官兩階，六十以下者進官一階，並給半俸。

translations.literal: Those aged sixty and above were promoted two ranks; those below sixty one rank; all were granted half salary.
translations.idiomatic: Men of sixty and above were advanced two ranks, those under sixty one rank, and all received half pay.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命應部除官嘗以罪罷而再敘者，遣使按其治跡，如有善狀，方許授以縣令，無治狀者，不以任數多少，並不得授。

translations.literal: On jiaxu it was ordered that for Ministry of Personnel appointees once dismissed for crime and now reinstated, envoys should examine their administrative record; only with a favorable report might they receive a county magistracy; without one, regardless of years of service, appointment was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the throne ruled that officials the Ministry of Personnel had reinstated after dismissal for crime must be investigated on their record; only with a good report could they receive a county post, and without one no term of service, however long, would qualify them.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，雷，雨雹，地生白毛。

translations.literal: On dinghai there was thunder, hail, and white fibers from the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai came thunder, hail, and white filaments from the earth.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，有司奏右司郎中段珪卒，上曰：「是人甚明正，可用者也。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renzi, the offices reported that Right Department director Duan Gui had died. The emperor said: “This man was very clear and upright—a usable talent.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renzi, the ministries reported the death of Right Department director Duan Gui. The emperor said: “He was notably upright and clear-minded—a man who could have been used.

sentences.zh: 如知登聞檢院巨構，每事但委順而已。

translations.literal: Men like Ju Gou of the Palace Memorial Transmission and Review Office only go along with whatever is asked on every matter.
translations.idiomatic: Men like Ju Gou at the Palace Memorial Transmission and Review Office simply defer on every question.

sentences.zh: 燕人自古忠直者鮮，遼兵至則從遼，宋人至則從宋，本朝至則從本朝，其俗詭隨，有自來矣！

translations.literal: Among Yan people the frankly loyal have been few since antiquity: when Liao troops came they followed Liao, when Song came they followed Song, when Our Dynasty came they followed Us—their custom is fickle; it has always been so!
translations.idiomatic: Yan folk have rarely been steadfast: Liao came and they served Liao, Song came and they served Song, We came and they served Us—their ways are opportunist, and always have been!

sentences.zh: 雖屢經遷變而未嘗殘破者，凡以此也。

translations.literal: That they have weathered many changes without being destroyed is entirely owing to this.
translations.idiomatic: That they have survived repeated upheavals without ruin is wholly due to this.

sentences.zh: 南人勁挺，敢言直諫者多，前有一人見殺，後複一人諫之，甚可尚也。

translations.literal: Southerners are firm and spirited; many dare speak blunt remonstrance. One man was killed for it, yet another remonstrated afterward—that is greatly to be honored.
translations.idiomatic: Southerners are tough and outspoken; many dare direct remonstrance. One was killed for it, yet another spoke up after him—that is deeply admirable.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「昨夕苦暑，朕通宵不寐，因念小民比屋卑隘，何以安處？」

translations.literal: ” He also said: “Last night’s heat was bitter; I lay awake the whole night, thinking how common folk live in cramped low houses—how can they bear it?”
translations.idiomatic: ” He added: “Yesterday’s heat was unbearable; I could not sleep all night, thinking how the people crowd into low, narrow houses—how do they endure it?”

sentences.zh: 七月乙酉，平章政事移剌道，參知政事張仲愈皆罷。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on yiyou, Chief Councillor Yelü Dao and Participation Councillor Zhang Zhongyu were both dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yiyou, Chief Councillor Yelü Dao and Participation Councillor Zhang Zhongyu were both removed.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫張汝霖坐失糾舉，降授棣州防禦使。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Zhang Rulin, for failing to impeach, was demoted to defender of Di Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Zhang Rulin, for lax impeachment, was reduced to defender of Di Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，觀稼於東郊。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on yiwei, he inspected the crops in the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiwei, he viewed the harvest in the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 以女直字《孝經》千部付點檢司分賜護衛親軍。

translations.literal: A thousand copies of the Classic of Filial Piety in Jurchen script were given to the Palace Front Inspectorate to distribute among the imperial guards.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand Jurchen-script copies of the Classic of Filial Piety were sent to the Palace Front Inspectorate for distribution among the imperial guards.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，還都。

translations.literal: On guimao he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，大名府猛安人馬和尚謀叛，伏誅。

translations.literal: On yisi Ma Heshang, a meng’an man of Daming Prefecture, plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Ma Heshang, a meng’an soldier of Daming Prefecture, plotted rebellion and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 括定猛安謀克戶口田土牛具。

translations.literal: Meng’an and mouke households, fields, and draft animals were registered and fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Meng’an and mouke households, land, and oxen were surveyed and registered.

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書程輝為參知政事。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Cheng Hui was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Hui, minister of revenue, became participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，以同僉大宗正事方等為賀宋生日使，宿直將軍完顏斜裏虎為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jisi, Associate Administrator of the Imperial Clan Court Fang Deng was made envoy to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday; duty-night general Wanyan Xielihu was envoy for Xia’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jisi, Fang Deng, associate administrator of the Imperial Clan Court, was sent to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday, and duty-night general Wanyan Xielihu for Xia’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 譯經所進所譯《易》、《書》、《論語》、《孟子》、《老子》、《楊子》、《文中子》、《劉子》及《新唐書》。

translations.literal: The Script Translation Institute presented its versions of the Changes, Documents, Analects, Mencius, Laozi, Yangzi, Zhongzi, Liuzi, and the New Book of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: The Script Translation Institute submitted its Jurchen renderings of the Changes, Documents, Analects, Mencius, Laozi, Yangzi, Zhongzi, Liuzi, and the New Book of Tang.

sentences.zh: 上謂宰臣曰：「朕所以令譯《五經》者，正欲女直人知仁義道德所在耳！

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief ministers: “I ordered the Five Classics translated precisely so that Jurchen people may know where benevolence, righteousness, and moral duty lie!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the chief ministers: “I had the Five Classics translated so Jurchens would know where benevolence, righteousness, and duty stand!

sentences.zh: 」命頒行之。

translations.literal: ” He ordered them promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: ” He commanded their promulgation.

sentences.zh: 辛未，秋獵。

translations.literal: On xinwei the autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the autumn hunt began.

sentences.zh: 十月癸巳，還都。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on guisi, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guisi, he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，幸東宮，賜皇孫吾都補洗兒禮。

translations.literal: On gengxu he visited the Eastern Palace and granted his grandson Wudubu the infant-bathing rite.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he went to the Eastern Palace and performed the infant-bathing rite for his grandson Wudubu.

sentences.zh: 己未，慶雲見。

translations.literal: On jiwei auspicious clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei auspicious clouds were seen.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On xinyou Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on renxu the new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renxu at the new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，平章政事蒲察通罷。

translations.literal: On bingyin Chief Councillor Pucha Tong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Chief Councillor Pucha Tong was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，歲星晝見。

translations.literal: On dingmao Jupiter was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Jupiter appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以樞密副使崇尹為平章政事。

translations.literal: On renshen Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Chong Yin was made chief councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Chong Yin became chief councillor.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲午，上謂宰臣曰：「帝王之政，固以寬慈為德，然如梁武帝專務寬慈，以至綱紀大壞。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on jiawu, the emperor told the chief ministers: “A ruler’s policy should indeed take lenience and kindness as virtue, yet when Emperor Wu of Liang made lenience his sole pursuit, the statutes collapsed utterly.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jiawu, he told the chief ministers: “Government should be lenient and kind, yet when Emperor Wu of Liang pursued lenience alone, law and order fell apart.

sentences.zh: 朕嘗思之，賞罰不濫，即是寬政也，余複何為？

translations.literal: I have reflected on this: when rewards and punishments are not abused, that is lenient government—what more is needed?
translations.idiomatic: I have thought about it: when reward and punishment are not misapplied, that is lenient rule—what else is required?

sentences.zh: 」以尚書左丞襄為平章政事，右丞張汝弼為左丞，參知政事粘割斡特剌為右丞，禮部尚書張汝霖為參知政事。

translations.literal: ” Xiang, left vice director of the Secretariat, was made chief councillor; Zhang Rubi, right vice director, became left vice director; Participation Councillor Niange Watele became right vice director; Minister of Rites Zhang Rulin became participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: ” Xiang, left vice director of the Secretariat, was made chief councillor; Zhang Rubi, right vice director, became left vice director; Participation Councillor Niange Watele became right vice director; and Zhang Rulin, minister of rites, became participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 以西京留守婆廬火等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: Poluohuo, keeper of the Western Capital, and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: Poluohuo, keeper of the Western Capital, and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the new year.

sentences.zh: 制外任官嘗為宰執者，凡吏牘上省部，依親王例，免書名。

translations.literal: A regulation: for officials in outer posts who had once been chief councillors, all clerical documents sent to the secretariat were, following the princes’ precedent, exempt from signing their names.
translations.idiomatic: It was decreed that former chief councillors serving in the provinces need not sign their names on documents sent to the secretariat, following the princes’ precedent.

sentences.zh: 戊午，歲星晝見。

translations.literal: On wuwu Jupiter was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Jupiter again appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 上謂宰臣曰：「女直進士可依漢兒進士補省令史。

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief ministers: “Jurchen jinshi may be appointed secretariat clerks on the same terms as Han jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: He told the chief ministers: “Jurchen jinshi graduates should fill secretariat clerkships on the same footing as Han jinshi.

sentences.zh: 夫儒者操行清潔，非禮不行。

translations.literal: Confucians keep their conduct pure and do nothing without ritual propriety.
translations.idiomatic: Confucian scholars keep their conduct clean and act only through ritual.

sentences.zh: 以吏出身者，自幼為吏，習其貪墨，至於為官，習性不能遷改。

translations.literal: Those raised from clerical service begin as clerks in youth, steeped in corruption; once they become officials, the habit cannot be shed.
translations.idiomatic: Men who rise from clerical ranks learn greed from youth as petty clerks; once they hold office, the habit does not leave them.

sentences.zh: 政道興廢，實由於此。

translations.literal: Whether government rises or falls depends on this in truth.
translations.idiomatic: Whether rule flourishes or fails turns on this.

sentences.zh: 」庚申，尚書省左司員外郎徐偉奏事，上謂宰臣曰：「斯人純而幹，有司郎中郭邦傑直而頗躁。

translations.literal: ” On gengshen Xu Wei, outer director of the Left Department of the Secretariat, memorialized. The emperor told the chief ministers: “This man is pure yet capable; Director Guo Bangjie is upright but rather rash.
translations.idiomatic: ” On gengshen Xu Wei, outer director of the Secretariat’s Left Department, presented a memorial. The emperor told the chief ministers: “This one is pure and able; Director Guo Bangjie is honest but somewhat hot-tempered.

sentences.zh: 」十二月癸酉，上謂宰臣曰：「海陵自以失道，恐上京宗室起而圖之，故不問疏近，並徙之南。

translations.literal: ” Twelfth month, on guiyou, the emperor told the chief ministers: “Hailing knew he had lost the Way and feared the imperial clan at the Upper Capital would rise against him, so without regard for near or distant kin he moved them all south.
translations.idiomatic: ” In the twelfth month, on guiyou, he told the chief ministers: “Hailing knew his course was wrong and feared the clan at the Upper Capital would plot against him, so kin near and far alike he transplanted to the south.

sentences.zh: 豈非以漢光武、宋康王之疏庶得繼大統，故有是心。

translations.literal: Was this not because obscure cadet lines like Han Guangwu and Song Kangwang had inherited the great mandate—hence that fear in his heart?
translations.idiomatic: Was it not because men of remote birth like Han Guangwu and Song Kangwang had seized the throne—hence that dread in his heart?

sentences.zh: 過慮若此，何其謬也。

translations.literal: To worry to such a degree—how mistaken!
translations.idiomatic: Such excessive anxiety—how wrongheaded!

sentences.zh: 」乙酉，高麗以母喪來告。

translations.literal: " On yiyou Goryeo reported its queen mother’s death.
translations.idiomatic: " On yiyou Goryeo sent word that the queen mother had died.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以真定尹烏古論元忠複為尚書右丞相。

translations.literal: On dinghai Zhending intendant Wugulun Yuanzhong was again made Right Chancellor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Zhending Intendant Wugulun Yuanzhong was again appointed right chancellor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 二十四年正月辛卯朔，宋、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Year twenty-four, first month, on xinmao the new moon, Song and Western Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-four, on the xinmao new moon of the first month, congratulatory envoys arrived from Song and Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 徐州進芝草十有八莖，真定進嘉禾二本，六莖，異畝同穎。

translations.literal: Xuzhou presented lingzhi with eighteen stalks; Zhending presented two fine-grain rice plants of six stalks each, different fields sharing one ear.
translations.idiomatic: Xuzhou offered lingzhi with eighteen stalks; Zhending offered two stands of auspicious grain, six stalks each, from separate fields but with a single ear.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，如長春宮春水。

translations.literal: On wuxu he went to Changchun Palace for the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he went to Changchun Palace for the spring waters.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，還都。

translations.literal: Second month, on renshen, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renshen, he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上曰：「朕將往上京。

translations.literal: On guiyou the emperor said: "I am about to go to the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the emperor said, "I am about to go to the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 念本朝風俗重端午節，比及端午到上京，則燕勞鄉間宗室父老。

translations.literal: Our dynasty’s custom sets great weight on the Dragon Boat festival; if I reach the Upper Capital by then, I can feast and reward the clansmen and elders of the homeland."
translations.idiomatic: Our people hold the Dragon Boat festival dear; if I arrive at the Upper Capital in time, I can feast the imperial clansmen and elders of the homeland."

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，制一品職事官庶孽子承廕，更不引見。

translations.literal: " On jiaxu an ordinance was issued: first-rank officials’ sons by concubines who inherit enfeoffment were no longer to be presented at court.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiaxu the court ruled that when sons by concubines of first-rank officials inherited enfeoffment, they would no longer be presented at court.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以東上閣門使完顏進兒等為高麗敕祭使，西上閣門使大仲尹為慰問使，虞王府長史永明為起複使，以器物局使皞為橫賜夏國使。

translations.literal: On bingxu Eastern Upper Gate Commissioner Wanyan Jin’er and others were made imperial mandate-sacrifice envoys to Goryeo; Western Upper Gate Commissioner Da Zhongyin was made consolation envoy; Chief Administrator of the Yu Prince’s Household Yongming was made envoy to urge resumption of mourning duties; Implements Bureau commissioner Hao was made transverse-bestowal envoy to Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Eastern Upper Gate Commissioner Wanyan Jin’er and others were sent as imperial mandate-sacrifice envoys to Goryeo; Western Upper Gate Commissioner Da Zhongyin as consolation envoy; Chief Administrator of the Yu Prince’s Household Yongming to urge resumption of office; and Implements Bureau Commissioner Hao as envoy bearing transverse gifts to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅朔，萬春節，宋、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Third month, on gengyin the new moon, the Ten-Thousand Springs festival; Song and Western Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengyin new moon, at the Ten-Thousand Springs festival congratulatory envoys came from Song and Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以上將如上京，尚書省奏定「皇太子守國諸儀」。

translations.literal: On jiawu, because the emperor was soon to go to the Upper Capital, the Secretariat memorialized and fixed the "protocol for the crown prince’s regency."
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, with the emperor about to go to the Upper Capital, the Secretariat submitted and settled the "protocol for the crown prince’s regency."

sentences.zh: 丙申，尚書省進「皇太子守國寶」，上召皇太子授之，且諭之曰：「上京祖宗興王之寺，欲與諸王一到，或留三二年，以汝守國。

translations.literal: On bingshen the Secretariat presented the "regency seal of the crown prince"; the emperor summoned the crown prince and invested him, instructing him: "The Upper Capital is the place where our forefathers rose to kingship; I wish to go there with the princes, or perhaps stay two or three years, and leave you to hold the state.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the Secretariat presented the "crown prince’s regency seal"; the emperor summoned the crown prince, invested him, and said: "The Upper Capital is where our forefathers rose to power; I mean to go there with the princes, perhaps for two or three years, and leave you to guard the realm.

sentences.zh: 譬之農家種田，商人營財，但能不墜父業，即為克家子，況社稷任重，尤宜畏慎。

translations.literal: It is like a farmer tending fields or a merchant managing wealth—so long as you do not let your father’s estate fall, you are a son who can maintain the house; how much more when the altars of state weigh upon you—you must be all the more fearful and careful.
translations.idiomatic: It is like a farmer in his fields or a merchant with his goods: if you do not let your father’s estate slip away, you are a son who can keep the house. How much more when the altars of state rest on you—you must be doubly fearful and careful.

sentences.zh: 常時觀汝甚謹，今日能紓朕優，乃見中心孝也。

translations.literal: I have always seen you very dutiful; that today you can ease my cares shows the true filial heart within."
translations.idiomatic: I have always found you very dutiful; that today you can lighten my burdens shows the filial heart I hoped for."

sentences.zh: 」皇太子再三辭讓，以不諳政務，乞備扈從。

translations.literal: " The crown prince repeatedly declined, saying he was not versed in government and begging to accompany him as escort.
translations.idiomatic: " The crown prince repeatedly declined, saying he did not yet know state affairs and begging to go along as escort.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「政事無甚難，但用心公正，毋納讒邪，久之自熟。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Government is not very difficult—only be fair in heart, do not admit slander, and in time you will grow skilled."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "State affairs are not so hard—only keep your heart fair, admit no slander, and in time you will grow skilled."

sentences.zh: 」皇太子流涕，左右皆為之感動。

translations.literal: " The crown prince wept, and those beside him were all moved.
translations.idiomatic: " The crown prince wept, and all beside him were moved.

sentences.zh: 皇太子乃受寶。

translations.literal: The crown prince then received the seal.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince then accepted the seal.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，如山陵。

translations.literal: On dingyou he went to the mountain tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he went to the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 己亥，還都。

translations.literal: On jihai he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，如上京。

translations.literal: On renyin he went to the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he went to the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 皇太子允恭守國。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Yungong held the state in regency.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Yungong held regency over the realm.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，宰執以下奉辭於通州。

translations.literal: On guimao the chief ministers and below took leave at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the chief ministers and below bade farewell at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 上謂宰執曰：「卿輩皆故老，皇太子守國，宜悉心輔之，以副朕意。

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief ministers: "You are all old retainers; while the crown prince holds the state, you should devote yourselves to assisting him, to fulfill my intent."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the chief ministers, "You are all veterans; while the crown prince holds regency, assist him with all your hearts, as I expect."

sentences.zh: 」又謂樞密使徒單克寧曰：「朕巡省之後，脫或有事，卿必親之。

translations.literal: He also told Privy Commissioner Tudan Kening: "After I have made my tour, if anything should arise, you must handle it in person.
translations.idiomatic: He also told Privy Commissioner Tudan Kening, "After I have gone on tour, if anything should arise, you must see to it yourself.

sentences.zh: 毋忽細微，大難圖也。

translations.literal: Do not neglect the small, for great trouble is hard to remedy."
translations.idiomatic: Do not neglect small matters, for great trouble is hard to undo."

sentences.zh: 」又顧六部官曰：「朕聞省部文字多以小不合而駁之，苟求自便，致累歲不能結絕，朕甚惡之。

translations.literal: He also turned to the Six Ministries officials and said: "I hear that provincial and ministry documents are often rejected on minor discrepancies, officials seeking their own convenience, so cases drag on for years without settlement—I greatly detest this.
translations.idiomatic: He also turned to the Six Ministries officials and said, "I hear provincial and ministry papers are often rejected over trifles, officials seeking their own ease, so suits drag on for years—I detest this.

sentences.zh: 自今可行則行，可罷則罷，毋使在下有滯留之歎！

translations.literal: From now on, what can be done, do; what can be dropped, drop—do not let those below sigh at being held up!"
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter, what can be done, do; what can be set aside, set aside—do not let people below groan at delay!"

sentences.zh: 」時諸王皆從，以趙王永中留輔太子。

translations.literal: At that time all the princes followed; Prince Zhao Yongzhong was left to assist the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: All the princes went with him; Prince Zhao Yongzhong was left to assist the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 四月己未朔，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on jiwei the new moon, Venus was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the jiwei new moon, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 咸平尹移剌道薨。

translations.literal: Xianping intendant Yila Dao died.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping Intendant Yila Dao died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，次廣寧府。

translations.literal: On gengshen he halted at Guangning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he stopped at Guangning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，次東京。

translations.literal: On bingyin he halted at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he stopped at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，朝謁孝甯宮。

translations.literal: On dingmao he paid court at the Xiaoning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he paid court at the Xiaoning Palace.

sentences.zh: 給複東京百里內夏秋稅租一年。

translations.literal: Summer and autumn tax and rent within a hundred li were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Summer and autumn tax and rent within a hundred li were remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 在城隨關年七十者補一官。

translations.literal: In the capital, those on the household registers who were seventy were each granted an office.
translations.idiomatic: In the city, registered residents aged seventy were each granted an office.

sentences.zh: 曲赦百里內犯徒二年以下罪。

translations.literal: Within a hundred li, penal labor up to two years was pardoned by special grace.
translations.idiomatic: Within a hundred li, penal labor up to two years was pardoned by special grace.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，觀漁于混同江。

translations.literal: On yiyou he watched fishing on the Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he watched fishing on the Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，至上京，居於光興宮。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jichou, he reached the Upper Capital and lodged at the Guangxing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jichou, he reached the Upper Capital and lodged at Guangxing Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，朝謁于慶元宮。

translations.literal: On gengyin he paid court at the Qingyuan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he paid court at Qingyuan Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，宴于皇武殿。

translations.literal: On wuxu he feasted in the Huangwu Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he gave a feast in the Huangwu Hall.

sentences.zh: 上謂宗戚曰：「朕思故鄉，積有日矣，今既至此，可極歡飲，君臣同之。

translations.literal: The emperor told the imperial kin: "I have long wished to see my homeland; now that I am here, let us drink to the full—ruler and subjects alike."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the imperial kin, "I have longed for my homeland many days; now that I am here, let us drink our fill—ruler and subjects together."

sentences.zh: 」賜諸王妃、主，宰執百官命婦各有差。

translations.literal: Princesses, chief ministers, and the wives of the hundred officials were each granted gifts in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial princesses, chief ministers, and officials’ wives were each granted gifts in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 宗戚皆沾醉起舞，竟日乃罷。

translations.literal: The kin all drank until drunk and danced; only at day’s end did it break up.
translations.idiomatic: The kin all drank until drunk and danced; the revel lasted all day before it ended.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，幸按出虎水臨漪亭。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on xinyou, he visited the Linqi Pavilion on the Anshe River.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinyou, he visited the Linqi Pavilion on the Anshe River.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，閱馬於綠野澱。

translations.literal: On renxu he reviewed horses at Lüye Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he reviewed horses at Lüye Marsh.

sentences.zh: 七月乙未，上謂宰臣曰：「天子巡狩當舉善罰惡。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on yiwei, the emperor told the chief ministers: "When the Son of Heaven makes the royal tour he should promote the good and punish the wicked.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yiwei, the emperor told the chief ministers, "When the Son of Heaven tours the realm he should promote the good and punish the wicked.

sentences.zh: 凡士民之孝弟淵睦者舉而用之，其不顧廉恥無行之人則教戒之，不悛者則加懲罰。

translations.literal: All commoners who show filial piety, brotherly duty, and deep harmony among neighbors—promote and employ them; those who disregard shame and have no proper conduct—admonish and instruct them, and if they do not reform, add punishment."
translations.idiomatic: Wherever the people show filial piety, brotherly duty, and close harmony among neighbors, promote and employ them; those who disregard shame and live without proper conduct, admonish and instruct, and if they do not reform, punish them."

sentences.zh: 」丙午，獵於勃野澱。

translations.literal: " On bingwu he hunted at Boyeqi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingwu he hunted at Boyeqi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上謂宰臣曰：「今時之人，有罪不問，既過之後則謂不知。

translations.literal: On yimao the emperor told the chief ministers: "People today, when there is guilt, do not inquire; after the fault has passed they say they did not know.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the emperor told the chief ministers, "Nowadays when men are guilty no one questions them; once the moment has passed they plead ignorance.

sentences.zh: 有罪必責，則謂每事尋罪。

translations.literal: When guilt must be punished, they say every matter is hunted for crime.
translations.idiomatic: When guilt is pursued they complain that every affair is raked for blame.

sentences.zh: 風俗之薄如此。

translations.literal: Custom has grown this thin.
translations.idiomatic: Morals have thinned to this degree.

sentences.zh: 不以文德感化，不能複于古也。

translations.literal: Without civil virtue to transform them, one cannot return to antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Without civil virtue to win men over, we cannot recover the ways of old.

sentences.zh: 卿等以德輔佐，當使複還古風。」

translations.literal: You must aid with virtue and restore the ancient wind."
translations.idiomatic: Aid me with virtue and bring back the ancient ways."

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，乙太府監張大節等為賀宋生日使，侍御史遙裏特末哥為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on guihai, Grand Storehouse Supervisor Zhang Dajie and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the imperial birthday; Censor-in-Chief Yaoli Temuge was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guihai, Grand Storehouse Supervisor Zhang Dajie and others were sent as Song birthday envoys, and Censor-in-Chief Yaoli Temuge as Western Xia birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔免上京今年市稅。

translations.literal: On yihai an edict exempted this year’s market taxes at the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the throne exempted the Upper Capital’s market taxes for the year.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，歲星晝見。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jiachen, Jupiter was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiachen, Jupiter appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 十月丁卯，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on dingmao, he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on dingmao, he hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，還宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on xinmao, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinmao, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔以上京天寒地遠，宋正旦、生日，高麗、夏國生日，並不須遣使，令有司報諭。

translations.literal: On jiawu an edict held that because the Upper Capital was cold and far, for Song’s New Year and imperial birthday and for Goryeo and Western Xia birthdays envoys need not be sent; the relevant offices were to report by notice.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu an edict ruled that because the Upper Capital was cold and remote, no envoys need be sent for Song’s New Year and birthday or for Goryeo and Western Xia birthdays; the ministries were to notify them in writing.

sentences.zh: 丙午尚書省奏徙速頻、胡裏改三猛安二十四謀克以實上京。

translations.literal: On bingwu the Secretariat memorialized moving twenty-four mouke of three meng’an from Supin and Huligai to strengthen the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the Secretariat asked to relocate twenty-four mouke in three meng’an from Supin and Huligai to fill out the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on bingchen, he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingchen, he hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 己卯，還宮。

translations.literal: On jimao he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 二十五年正月乙酉朔。

translations.literal: Year twenty-five, first month, on yiyou the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-five, on the yiyou new moon of the first month.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，宴妃嬪、親王、公主、文武從官於光德殿，宗室、宗婦及五品以上命婦，與坐者千七百餘人，賞賚有差。

translations.literal: On dinghai he feasted consorts, imperial princes, princesses, and civil and military attendants in the Guangde Hall; imperial kin, their wives, and titled wives of fifth rank and above who shared the seats numbered more than seventeen hundred, and gifts were graded.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he feasted consorts, imperial princes, princesses, and civil and military followers in the Guangde Hall; more than seventeen hundred imperial kin, clan wives, and titled wives of fifth rank and above took seats, and rewards were graded.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，以東平尹鳥古論思列怨望，殺之。

translations.literal: Second month, on guiyou, because Dongping Intendant Wugulun Silie harbored resentment, he was put to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guiyou, Dongping Intendant Wugulun Silie was executed for disaffection.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，如春水。

translations.literal: On dingchou he went to the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he went to the spring-waters hunt.

sentences.zh: 四月己未，至自春水。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on jiwei, he returned from the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiwei, he returned from the spring waters.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，幸皇武殿擊球，許士民縱觀。

translations.literal: On guihai he visited the Huangwu Hall to play cuju and allowed scholars and commoners to watch freely.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he went to the Huangwu Hall for cuju and let scholars and commoners watch at will.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔於速頻、胡裏改兩路猛安下選三十謀克為三猛安，移置於率督畔窟之地，以實上京。

translations.literal: On jiazi an edict ordered that under the meng’an of the Supin and Huligai circuits thirty mouke be chosen to form three meng’an and moved to the Shuaidu Banku lands to strengthen the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the throne ordered thirty mouke chosen from meng’an under the Supin and Huligai circuits to form three meng’an and resettled at Shuaidu Banku to fill out the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬申，曲赦會寧府仍放免今年租稅，百姓年七十以上者補一官。

translations.literal: On renshen a partial amnesty was granted to Huining Prefecture and this year’s land tax was remitted; commoners aged seventy and above were granted one office.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Huining Prefecture received a partial amnesty and this year’s land tax was remitted; commoners of seventy and above were granted one rank.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以會寧府官一人兼大宗正丞，以治宗室之政。

translations.literal: On jiaxu one Huining prefectural official was made to hold concurrently the deputy director of the Grand Imperial Clan Court to administer clan affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu one official of Huining Prefecture was named to serve concurrently as deputy director of the Grand Imperial Clan Court and govern clan affairs.

sentences.zh: 上謂群臣曰：「上京風物朕自樂之，每奏還都，輒用感愴。

translations.literal: The emperor told the assembled ministers: "The sights of the Upper Capital I enjoy for myself; whenever memorials urge return to the capital I am moved to grief.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the assembled ministers, "I delight in the Upper Capital’s scenes myself; whenever memorials urge return to the capital I am overcome with grief.

sentences.zh: 祖宗舊邦，不忍舍去，萬歲之後，當置朕于太祖之側，卿等無忘朕言。

translations.literal: The old land of the ancestors—I cannot bear to leave it; after my ten thousand years I should be placed at Taizu’s side—do not forget my words."
translations.idiomatic: Our ancestors’ homeland—I cannot bear to leave it; when my ten thousand years are done place me at Taizu’s side—do not forget what I say."

sentences.zh: 」丁丑，宴宗室、宗婦于皇武殿，大功親賜官三階，小功二階，緦麻一階，年高屬近者加宣武將軍。

translations.literal: " On dingchou he feasted the imperial kin and their wives in the Huangwu Hall; kin in the greatest mourning degree were granted three ranks, in the middle degree two, in the least one; the aged and near in kinship received in addition the rank General Who Manifests Martiality.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingchou he feasted the imperial kin and clan wives in the Huangwu Hall; kin in the greatest mourning degree were advanced three ranks, in the middle two, in the least one; the aged and close in kinship were also made General Who Manifests Martiality.

sentences.zh: 及封宗女，賜銀、絹各有差。

translations.literal: When clan daughters were enfeoffed, silver and silk were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: As clan daughters were enfeoffed, silver and silk were granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 曰：「朕尋常不飲酒，今日甚欲成醉，此樂亦不易得也！

translations.literal: He said: "I ordinarily do not drink, but today I greatly wish to become drunk—this joy is not easily won!"
translations.idiomatic: He said, "I seldom drink, yet today I long to drink my fill—such joy is not easily had!"

sentences.zh: 」宗室婦女及群臣故老以次起舞，進酒。

translations.literal: " Imperial kin women and veteran ministers in turn rose to dance and offer wine.
translations.idiomatic: " Clan women and veteran ministers in turn rose to dance and offer wine.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「吾來數月，未有一人歌本曲者，吾為汝等歌之。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "I have been here several months and not one person has sung the homeland tune—I will sing it for you."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "I have been here months and not one of you has sung the homeland tune—I will sing it for you."

sentences.zh: 」命宗室弟敘坐殿下者皆坐殿上，聽上自歌。

translations.literal: " He ordered imperial kin brothers seated in order below the hall to sit on the hall and listen as the emperor sang himself.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered younger imperial kin seated in order below the hall to take seats on the dais and hear him sing himself.

sentences.zh: 其詞道王業之艱難，及繼述之不易，至「慨想祖宗，宛然如睹」，慷慨悲激，不能成聲，歌畢泣下。

translations.literal: The words told of the hardship of founding the royal enterprise and the difficulty of carrying it on; reaching "thinking of the ancestors, it seems I see them face to face," he was stirred, grief-stricken, and could not finish the notes; when the song ended he wept.
translations.idiomatic: The lyrics spoke of the hardship of founding the realm and the difficulty of succession; at the line "thinking of the ancestors, it seems I see them plain," he grew impassioned and grief-stricken and could not finish the tune; when the song ended he wept.

sentences.zh: 右丞相元忠率群臣、宗戚捧觴上壽，皆稱萬歲。

translations.literal: Right Chancellor Yuanzhong led the assembled ministers and kin to raise cups and offer longevity; all cried "Ten thousand years!"
translations.idiomatic: Right Chancellor Yuanzhong led ministers and kin to raise cups and wish long life; all shouted "Ten thousand years!"

sentences.zh: 於是，諸夫人更歌本曲，如私家之會。

translations.literal: Thereupon the ladies again sang the homeland tunes, like a private family gathering.
translations.idiomatic: Then the ladies again sang homeland tunes, as at a family gathering.

sentences.zh: 既醉，上複續調，至一鼓乃罷。

translations.literal: When drunk, the emperor again took up the tune and did not stop until the first watch.
translations.idiomatic: Once drunk, the emperor took up the tune again and did not leave off until the first watch.

sentences.zh: 己卯，發上京。

translations.literal: On jimao he set out from the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he departed the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，宗室戚屬奉辭。

translations.literal: On gengchen the imperial kin and affinal kin came to take leave.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the imperial kin and affinal kin came to bid farewell.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「朕久思故鄉，甚欲留一二歲，京師天下根本，不能久於此也。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "I have long missed my homeland and wished greatly to stay one or two years more, but the capital is the root of all under Heaven—I cannot remain here long.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "I have longed for my homeland and wished to stay another year or two, but the capital is the root of the realm—I cannot linger here.

sentences.zh: 太平歲久，國無征徭，汝等皆奢縱，往往貧乏，朕甚憐之。

translations.literal: Peace has lasted many years and the state levies no campaigns; you all grow extravagant and often fall into want—I pity you deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Peace has lasted many years and the state levies no campaigns; you grow extravagant and often fall into want—I pity you deeply.

sentences.zh: 當務儉約，無忘祖先艱難。

translations.literal: You must practice thrift and not forget the ancestors’ hardship."
translations.idiomatic: Practice thrift and do not forget the ancestors’ hardship."

sentences.zh: 」因泣數行下，宗室戚屬皆感泣而退。

translations.literal: Thereupon he wept several lines of tears and the imperial kin and affinal kin, all moved, wept as they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: He wept several lines of tears; the imperial kin and affinal kin, all moved, wept as they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，平章政事襄、奉禦平山等射懷孕兔。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on gengyin, Chief Councillor Xiang, Imperial Attendant Pingshan, and others shot a pregnant hare.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengyin, Chief Councillor Xiang, Imperial Attendant Pingshan, and others shot a pregnant hare.

sentences.zh: 上怒杖平山三十，召襄誡飭之，遂下詔禁射兔。

translations.literal: The emperor in anger caned Pingshan thirty strokes, summoned Xiang to admonish him, and then issued an edict forbidding the shooting of hares.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in anger gave Pingshan thirty strokes of the rod, summoned Xiang to rebuke him, and then forbade the shooting of hares by edict.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，次天平山好水川。

translations.literal: On renyin he halted at Tianping Mountain on the Haoshui River.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he halted at Tianping Mountain on the Haoshui River.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，遣使臨潢、泰州勸農。

translations.literal: On guimao he sent envoys to Linhuang and Taizhou to encourage farming.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he sent envoys to Linhuang and Taizhou to encourage agriculture.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命尚書省奏事衣窄紫。

translations.literal: On bingwu he ordered the Secretariat to memorialize in narrow-cut purple robes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he ordered the Secretariat to present memorials in narrow-cut purple.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，獵近山，見田壟不治，命笞田者。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiayin, he hunted in the nearby hills; seeing fields untended, he ordered the farmers flogged.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiayin, he hunted in the nearby hills; seeing untilled ridges, he had the farmers caned.

sentences.zh: 庚申，皇太子允恭薨。

translations.literal: On gengshen Crown Prince Yungong died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Crown Prince Yungong died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，尚書右丞相烏古論元忠罷。

translations.literal: On bingyin Right Chancellor Wugulun Yuanzhong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Right Chancellor Wugulun Yuanzhong left office.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣左宣徽使唐括鼎詣京師，致祭皇太子。

translations.literal: On gengwu he dispatched Left Xuanhui Commissioner Tangguo Ding to the capital to conduct memorial rites for the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he sent Left Xuanhui Commissioner Tangguo Ding to the capital to perform mourning rites for the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命皇太子妃及諸皇孫執喪。

translations.literal: On wuyin the crown princess and all imperial grandsons were ordered to observe mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the crown prince’s consort and all imperial grandsons were ordered to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 並用漢儀。

translations.literal: Han rites were used throughout.
translations.idiomatic: Han mourning rites were used throughout.

sentences.zh: 七月戊申，發好水川。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on wushen, he set out from Haoshui River.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wushen, he departed Haoshui River.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳朔，次轄沙河，賜百歲老嫗帛。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on xinsi the new moon, he halted at Xiahe River and granted silk to centenarian old women.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinsi new moon, he stopped at Xiahe River and granted silk to women a hundred years old.

sentences.zh: 甲申，次遼水，召見百二十歲女直老人，能道太祖開創事，上嘉歎，賜食，並賜帛。

translations.literal: On jiashen he halted at the Liao River and summoned a Jurchen elder of a hundred and twenty who could recount Taizu’s founding; the emperor praised and sighed, gave him food, and also granted silk.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he stopped at the Liao River and summoned a Jurchen elder of a hundred and twenty who could tell of Taizu’s founding; the emperor praised him, gave him food, and granted silk as well.

sentences.zh: 己酉，至自上京。

translations.literal: On jiyou he arrived from the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he returned from the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 是日，上臨奠宣孝皇太子于熙春園。

translations.literal: That day the emperor came in person to offer mourning for the Xuanxiao Crown Prince at Xichun Garden.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emperor came in person to mourn the Xuanxiao Crown Prince at Xichun Garden.

sentences.zh: 十月丙辰，尚書省奏親軍數多，宜稍減損，詔定額為三千。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on bingchen, the Secretariat memorialized that the personal guard was too numerous and should be somewhat reduced; an edict fixed the quota at three thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on bingchen, the Secretariat reported that the personal guard was too large and should be cut back; an edict fixed the quota at three thousand.

sentences.zh: 宰臣退，上謂左右曰：「宰相年老艱于久立，可置小榻廊下，使少休息。

translations.literal: When the chancellors withdrew, the emperor told those beside him: "The chancellors are old and find it hard to stand long; set small couches in the corridor below so they may rest a little."
translations.idiomatic: When the chancellors withdrew, the emperor told those beside him, "The chancellors are old and cannot stand long; place small couches in the corridor below so they may rest a little."

sentences.zh: 」甲子，禁上京等路大雪及含胎時採捕。

translations.literal: " On jiazi hunting and capture were forbidden on the Upper Capital routes during heavy snow and when beasts were with young.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiazi hunting and trapping were forbidden on the Upper Capital routes during heavy snow and when animals were pregnant.

sentences.zh: 上謂宰臣曰：「護衛年老出職而授臨民，手字尚不能畫，何以治民？

translations.literal: The emperor told the chancellors: "When aged guards leave service and are posted to govern the people, they cannot even draw the characters for their own hand—how can they govern the people?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the chancellors, "When aged guards leave service and are sent to govern the people, they cannot even write their own names—how can they govern the people?

sentences.zh: 人胸中明暗外不能知，精神昏耄已見於外，是強其所不能也。

translations.literal: What is bright or dark in a man’s breast cannot be known from outside, but when the mind is feeble and senile it shows on the outside—this is forcing what they cannot do.
translations.idiomatic: What is clear or clouded in a man’s breast cannot be known from outside, but when the mind is dull and senile it shows on the outside—this is forcing what they cannot do.

sentences.zh: 天子以兆民為子，不能家家而撫，在用人而已。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven takes the myriad people as his children; he cannot comfort every household himself—it rests only on employing men.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven takes the myriad people as his children; he cannot comfort every household himself—it rests only on whom he employs.

sentences.zh: 知其不能而強授之，百姓其謂我何？

translations.literal: If we know they cannot do it and yet force the post on them, what will the people think of me?"
translations.idiomatic: If we know they cannot do it and yet force office on them, what will the people think of me?"
